meta.hardware: Mac17,9 · Apple M5 Pro · 15 CPUs · 48 GiB
meta.driver: scratch Rust binary (not committed) linking pw-perf: temp PITWALL_*_DIR + untrusted registered empty project (pw_perf::register_untrusted), disclaimed spawn of <bundle>/Contents/MacOS/pitwall <project> (pw_perf::macos::spawn_disclaimed), first_frame mark, memory = phys_footprint sum over the responsible-pid group (same as pw-perf), quit by pid (AppKit terminate)
meta.what:
idle memory with one `pitwall mcp --project

` session (initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list; then held open). mem: sample0 = first frame + 10 s, then the session attaches (mcp runs) or nothing (control runs), sample1 = 10 s later; run 0 warm-up; alternating. mem_long: samples every 10 s up to 60 s after the attach point, no warm-up. The proxy process is spawned normally and is not in the app's group; its own footprint is under session.proxy
